data.description: Deferred at the 2026-08-11 escalations grill (Brandon chose convention + collapse for now — see tuh-01KZPYFK8GFXQ5T2GFPCRQ8E86). The idea: give `escalate` optional structured `options` / `recommendation` fields so the TUI can render escalation options as pickable answers instead of free-text entry. T3-additive on the event shape, but it extends a T5 verb's input surface and changes the answer flow — needs its own grill before building. Revisit after launch gates land.
data.title: Structured escalation options: pickable answers in the TUI (escalate gains options/recommendation fields)
